🔥 WifiWatch | C#
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide users with real-time monitoring and historical logging of their Wi-Fi network performance, identifying and diagnosing connection issues.
✨ Key Features: • Live status of Wi-Fi, router, and internet • Logs and categorizes network problems (Wi-Fi, home network, provider, DNS) • Intelligent notifications for serious or persistent issues • DFS channel change warnings due to radar
📖 Summary: Wifi Watch is a Windows 11 tray application written in C# that monitors your Wi-Fi connection's channel, signal strength, and ping latency. It logs network issues, identifies their source (Wi-Fi, home network, provider, or DNS), and notifies users of significant or prolonged problems, including warnings about DFS channel changes due to radar.
